description: Classroom ceiling projector will not turn on and status LED is blinking orange
resolution: Replaced blown projector bulb and reseated internal power supply connection in lecture hall.

description: Cannot connect to Campus-Secure Wi-Fi on MacBook running macOS Sequoia
resolution: Cleared expired enterprise 802.1x security certificate and re-enrolled user mobileconfig profile.

description: User locked out of ERP financial portal after three incorrect password attempts
resolution: Verified staff identity via employee ID and triggered Active Directory account unlock and password reset link.

description: SPSS statistical package terminates immediately with missing MSVCR120.dll runtime error
resolution: Installed Microsoft Visual C++ 2013 Redistributable package and repaired application registry keys.

description: Core PostgreSQL database rejecting connections with pool exhaustion error
resolution: Terminated orphaned idle-in-transaction connections and adjusted max_connections pool settings in postgresql.conf.

description: Entire 2nd floor has lost wired and wireless internet connectivity
resolution: Replaced failed PoE distribution switch in 2nd floor IDF communications closet and restored trunk uplink.

description: Department shared mailbox helpdesk@campus.edu not updating in Outlook desktop app
resolution: Renamed corrupted OST offline cache file and allowed Outlook to perform full Exchange mailbox re-sync.

description: Lab workstation PC-12 bluescreens with MEMORY_MANAGEMENT stop code on boot
resolution: Ran MemTest86, isolated faulty 8GB DDR4 RAM stick in DIMM slot 2, and replaced with spare module.

description: New postdoctoral researcher requires read and write permissions to Genomics SharePoint site
resolution: Added researcher account to Active Directory group SG-LifeSci-Genomics-Contributors with principal investigator approval.

description: Student admissions portal displays HTTP 502 Bad Gateway to all external applicants
resolution: Investigated upstream Gunicorn app worker crash caused by memory leak; restarted service and applied memory limit patch.

description: Left blue Sandisk USB flash drive plugged into computer kiosk 3
resolution: Retrieved flash drive from kiosk 3, logged into campus lost & found registry, and returned upon student ID check.

description: Canvas LMS gradebook spreadsheet export hangs indefinitely on large roster classes
resolution: Flushed stalled Redis celery worker queue processing asynchronous gradebook CSV exports and increased worker concurrency.

description: Network label printer in clinic reception prints continuous blank labels
resolution: Cleaned optical gap sensor with isopropyl alcohol, recalibrated media sensor, and updated Zebra thermal printer driver.

description: Zoom screen sharing fails with black screen when participating in hybrid lecture
resolution: Disabled hardware video acceleration in Zoom client advanced settings and updated Intel integrated graphics driver.

description: Exam hall Wi-Fi outage affecting 120 students during midterm examination
resolution: Power-cycled high-density Cisco access points in Exam Hall, restarted DHCP relay daemon, and restored SSID association.

description: Several staff members in Block B cannot connect to campus network or internet
resolution: Rebooted edge access switch in Block B network room and re-enabled disabled trunk port connecting to core router.

description: One desktop computer in computer Lab 3 will not turn on no lights or fan sounds
resolution: Replaced blown 450W ATX power supply unit in Lab 3 workstation and verified successful boot to desktop.

description: Routine request to install Python 3.11 and scientific computing libraries for next semester lab
resolution: Deployed standardized Python 3.11 scientific environment package containing numpy, pandas, and matplotlib via SCCM image.

description: Wi-Fi signal keeps dropping and disconnecting in Library study cubicles on 3rd floor
resolution: Adjusted radio transmit power levels on 3rd floor Aruba AP-555 access point and resolved co-channel interference.

description: Campus core DNS server not responding causing website lookups to fail across campus
resolution: Restarted named BIND9 DNS service on primary domain controller and cleared stale DNS forwarder cache.

description: Classroom sound system and microphone producing loud squealing feedback and static
resolution: Replaced defective 3.5mm audio patch cable and balanced microphone gain levels on Crestron mixer console.

description: Staff member needs password reset for Windows Active Directory account after returning from leave
resolution: Verified employee identity through manager authorization and issued temporary password reset with mandatory change at next logon.

description: Ethernet wall jack in room 304 has broken internal pins and cable will not click in
resolution: Punched down new Cat6 RJ45 keystone jack into wall faceplate and verified 1Gbps link with Fluke cable tester.

description: MATLAB network license server checkout failed error code -15 cannot connect to license server
resolution: Restarted FlexLM license daemon service on campus licensing server and updated client network firewall exception.

description: Staff laptop battery is physically swollen pushing touchpad out of laptop casing
resolution: Immediately depowered laptop, removed swollen Li-ion battery safely for hazmat recycling, and installed OEM replacement battery.

description: MySQL student registration database experiencing severe lock contention and slow queries
resolution: Killed unindexed long-running report query blocking transaction tables and added composite index on enrollment table.

description: Staff member unable to receive Microsoft Authenticator MFA push notifications on new phone
resolution: Revoked old MFA device registration in Azure AD portal and initiated QR code re-enrollment flow for new handset.

description: Public network printer on second floor of Library is displaying Paper Jam error in Tray 2
resolution: Cleared crumpled cardstock obstruction from Tray 2 pickup rollers and cleaned rubber feed wheels.

description: Cannot connect to campus GlobalProtect VPN gateway authentication timeout error
resolution: Renewed expired SSL certificate on Palo Alto VPN portal gateway and restarted gateway service daemon.

description: Instructor desktop PC in Room 201 showing BitLocker recovery key screen upon startup
resolution: Retrieved BitLocker 48-digit recovery key from Active Directory computer object and updated TPM firmware baseline.

description: DHCP IP address conflict error in Quad A dormitory network devices cannot get IP address
resolution: Located and disabled unauthorized rogue consumer Wi-Fi router broadcasting rogue DHCP leases in room 214.

description: Departmental distribution email list bouncing incoming emails with error 550 Relaying Denied
resolution: Updated Exchange online distribution group delivery management settings to accept messages from external authenticated senders.

description: SolidWorks 3D CAD application crashes when opening complex assembly files with OpenGL error
resolution: Installed Nvidia workstation certified graphics driver and configured SolidWorks to utilize dedicated discrete GPU.

description: Redis session cache cluster exhausted available memory causing web sessions to log out
resolution: Purged stale expired user session keys and increased Redis maxmemory policy to allkeys-lru with 4GB threshold.

description: Instructor podium HDMI video flickers black every few seconds during lecture presentation
resolution: Replaced damaged high-speed HDMI cable and updated Crestron transmitter firmware in podium AV enclosure.

description: New staff member in human resources requires access to HR shared network drive
resolution: Mapped secure network share drive H: and granted NTFS read-write permissions via Active Directory security group.

description: OneDrive desktop client stuck on Processing changes and will not sync course files
resolution: Reset OneDrive client cache using onedrive.exe /reset command and cleared zero-byte locked temporary file.

description: Laboratory workstation hard drive making repetitive clicking noise and failing SMART diagnostics
resolution: Cloned failing 1TB SATA HDD immediately to new 1TB NVMe SSD and verified zero data corruption.

description: Request for dual monitor desk arm installation and ergonomic vertical mouse setup
resolution: Installed heavy-duty dual monitor desk mount and configured ergonomic peripherals for staff workstation.

description: Engineering computer lab PCs require RStudio and tidyverse installation for upcoming stats lab
resolution: Pushed silent RStudio installation script and pre-compiled R packages to 35 lab computers via network deployment.

description: Microsoft SQL Server database transaction log file full rejecting all INSERT transactions
resolution: Executed transaction log backup to release inactive log space and expanded transaction log drive capacity by 50GB.

description: Wireless network connection keeps disconnecting when walking between student union and library
resolution: Enabled 802.11r fast BSS transition roaming on outdoor campus wireless controller profile.

description: USB document camera not detected in seminar room computer during classroom presentation
resolution: Replaced faulty USB 3.0 extension repeater cable and reinstalled camera driver in Device Manager.

description: Microsoft Teams application fails to detect USB conference room microphone and camera
resolution: Updated Polycom studio conference bar firmware and configured default Teams audio devices in Windows sound settings.

description: Safe disposal and e-waste recycling of obsolete CRT monitors and decommissioned towers
resolution: Cataloged asset tags, pulled and physically degaussed hard drives, and scheduled certified e-waste recycler pickup.

description: Clinic workstation keyboard spacebar and enter keys physically sticking and not responding
resolution: Replaced contaminated membrane keyboard with new washable antimicrobial USB keyboard.

description: High performance computing cluster head node rejecting SSH connections due to MaxStartups limit
resolution: Increased sshd MaxStartups connection threshold in sshd_config and tuned fail2ban brute-force protection filter.

description: Cannot log into campus portal getting error authentication service temporarily unavailable
resolution: Renewed expired SAML signing certificate on Shibboleth identity provider and restarted IdP servlet container.

description: PostgreSQL database vacuum process consuming 100% disk IO slowing transaction processing
resolution: Adjusted autovacuum_vacuum_cost_limit and scheduled intensive vacuum analyze runs to off-peak overnight hours.

description: Wi-Fi in Science Hall Room 102 completely disconnected during chemistry lab lecture
resolution: Power-cycled PoE port on switch feeding Room 102 AP and verified all student tablets reconnected.
